lead: A `#[cfg(test)]` `Ctx::stdout()` in a crate the language server links fails `nvs-lsp`, not the crate you wrote it in.
body: `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/stdout_policy.rs` greps the *source text* of every linked crate, so a unit test that builds a context the obvious way leaves `cargo test -p nvs-stdlib` green and turns two `-p nvs-lsp` tests red, naming `rule:ide/stdout-belongs-to-the-protocol` rather than the member you were writing. Build a test context as `Ctx::new(OutputSink::Sink)`, which is what every other `nvs-stdlib` unit test already does.
